name: cascade-coding-agent
description: Integrates develop or the primary branch, resolves conflicts by authority, prepares reviewed changes for push, and engineers coding-agent harnesses.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate branches, prepare pushes, engineer harnesses.
interface.longDescription: Pull develop or the actual primary branch when develop is absent. Resolve textual and semantic conflicts using branch authority rather than chronology, preserve local intent, review the result, and prepare changes for push with explicit readiness and authorization. Also audit, adapt, and evolve coding-agent harnesses. The host retains execution, publishing and target-repository authority.
defaultPrompt: Audit or adapt this repository's coding-agent harness while preserving target authority.
Maintain this harness or integrate a reviewed agent architecture packet with the smallest validated change.
Integrate develop or the primary branch, review my changes, and prepare them for push with an adaptation report.
